issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method is declared with an empty parameter list (the parameter is commented out: private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), whereas the UML in the problem statement and the solution implement singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This creates a structural mismatch: students may implement or call the helper expecting an Animal parameter (as shown in the UML and solution), but the template's signature does not accept one, which can confuse students and prevent straightforward implementation of the verse helper.
issues.suggestedFix: Uncomment and restore the parameter in the template so the helper matches the UML and solution: change the method signature to private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java. Ensure any calls to the helper (from singFarmSong) pass the Animal argument accordingly.
